visual_action: A still photo of Donald Trump pointing at the camera, followed by a close-up clip of him speaking. The video is presented in a vertical, phone-screen format.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown in the video, and the on-screen text explicitly mentions the "Trump special".

on_screen_text.text: “I start to learn how to help the American people.”

spoken_summary: The audio is a well-known interview clip with French soccer player Kylian Mbappé. He says, "I start to learn how to cook," an interviewer asks, "What's the Mbappé special?" and he replies, "For the moment, nothing." The on-screen text replaces the original dialogue with a political parallel, subtitling Mbappé's voice to appear as if Trump is being discussed.
audio_music: The audio is a viral sound clip from an interview with soccer player Kylian Mbappé, where he admits he is learning to cook but has no special dish yet. It's used here for comedic and mocking effect.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a simple cut from a still image to a short video clip.
central_claim: Donald Trump has no substantive plan or 'special' way to help the American people, despite his claims.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and portray him as lacking in substance or specific plans.
